title: Define llms.txt RFC standard and tooling ecosystem
description:
CONTEXT BLOCK:

- **File/Function:** `doc_transformer/src/llms.rs` (~340 LOC) - generates llms.txt AI entry points
- **The Smell:** llms.txt is a novel format but not standardized. No ecosystem of tools (validators, parsers, generators). Needs RFC-style specification and community adoption.
- **Opportunity:** Define THE standard for AI documentation entry points (like robots.txt for AI)

SPECIFICATION BLOCK (The "One-Shot" Instructions):

1. **EARS (Easy Approach to Requirements Syntax):**
   - When a project wants to expose docs to AI, they shall create llms.txt following the RFC spec.
   - When AI encounters llms.txt, it shall parse per the standard format (URL list with metadata).
   - When developers validate llms.txt, they shall use the official validator tool.
   - When the RFC is published, it shall be hosted at llms.txt.org or similar.

2. **DbC (Design by Contract):**
   - **Preconditions:**
     - llms.txt format is well-defined (syntax, semantics)
     - Multiple example llms.txt files exist
     - Validator can check conformance
   - **Postconditions:**
     - RFC document published (markdown + HTML)
     - Validator tool available (CLI + library)
     - Parser library available (Rust crate)
     - Community site with examples

3. **Schema & Edge Cases:**

   **llms.txt Format (v1.0):**
   ```
   # AI Documentation Entry Points
   # Generated: 2026-01-11

   ## Overview
   https://example.com/docs/INDEX.json
   https://example.com/docs/COMPASS.md

   ## API Reference
   https://example.com/api/reference.json

   ## Tutorials
   https://example.com/tutorials/getting-started.md
   ```

   **Schema Requirements:**
   - Lines starting with `#` are comments
   - Lines starting with `##` are section headers
   - URLs must be absolute (https://)
   - Optional metadata: priority, last-modified

   **Edge Cases:**
     - Relative URLs → validator error
     - Malformed URLs → validator error
     - Duplicate URLs → validator warning
     - Empty file → validator error
     - Section with no URLs → validator warning

IMPLEMENTATION GUIDANCE:

1. Write RFC document: `llms-txt-spec/RFC.md`
2. Create validator crate: `llms-txt-validator`
3. Create parser crate: `llms-txt-parser`
4. Set up community site: llms.txt.org (GitHub Pages)
5. Submit to relevant communities (r/rust, Hacker News, AI forums)
6. Create examples from popular projects

DELIVERABLES:
- RFC document (markdown + rendered HTML)
- Validator CLI tool
- Parser library (Rust crate)
- Community site with examples
- Announcement blog post

REFERENCE:
- Current generator: `doc_transformer/src/llms.rs`
- Inspiration: robots.txt RFC, sitemap.xml spec
- Goal: Become the standard for AI documentation discovery
